notes: August 2026 cycle BASELINE. MozillaOnline -> canonical Firefox desktop migration overlay (adjustment code `o`), carried forward from July UNCHANGED so the August baseline isolates the effect of fresher data. The curve file is byte-identical to data-official/2026-07/mozillaonline/mozillaonline_migration_model.official.2026-06-29.parquet; only applies_to_forecast_start moved 2026-07-06 -> 2026-07-28 -> 2026-08-02 (the latter with the data refresh, curve still unchanged). Brad Ochocki Szasz's OFFICIAL model (Dec-15 28d-MA ~567K). Bidirectional overlay on legacy_desktop DAU: the migration DAU is subtracted from modern_windows training rows before mozaic (allocated across countries by the FIXED geo shares below, IR excluded, renormalized over training-present countries), then added back to the per-country + ALL forecast rows. OS scope is modern_windows-ONLY by measurement: the pre-transition MozillaOnline source population is 92% on recent Firefox within modern_windows, while older-Windows (winX) users are 99% pinned on ancient Firefox that cannot receive the migrating build. Fixed country shares (not trailing DAU) because MozillaOnline is a China-distribution product with a fixed geo footprint; window_days retained for schema compatibility but unused for fixed shares. Series held flat at the 2026-12-31 28d-MA (~550K) through the 2027-12-31 horizon (no cliff). CARRY-FORWARD CAVEAT: the migration was deliberately modelled conservatively (slower than actuals already showed in July), and training now extends ~5.5 weeks further (through 2026-08-01), so the extra training rows subtract a curve value likely BELOW the realized migration -- Prophet will absorb the residual into trend. This caveat GREW with the 2026-08-02 refresh: the carry-forward was explicitly retained through that refresh (user decision) so the refresh delta isolates fresher data, which means `o` is now the last stale overlay and the only one still pending re-measurement.
